LanguageData.LP_MO_CombatShape.label: combat wild shape
LanguageData.LP_MO_CombatShape.description: Become a fierce beast for 1 hour: melee damage ×1.4, armor +15%, movement ×1.15. Mana 1, cooldown 10 seconds. Circle of the Moon, druid level 2.
LanguageData.LP_MO_PrimalStrike.label: primal strike
LanguageData.LP_MO_PrimalStrike.description: Passive: in combat wild shape or elemental form, melee armor penetration +30%. Circle of the Moon, druid level 6.
LanguageData.LP_MO_ElementalForm.label: elemental wild shape
LanguageData.LP_MO_ElementalForm.description: Become an elemental for 1 hour: fire and cold damage halved, enemies within radius 2 take 6 × verdant power burn damage every 2 seconds. Mana 2, cooldown 30 seconds. Circle of the Moon, druid level 10.
LanguageData.LP_MO_ThousandForms.label: thousand forms
LanguageData.LP_MO_ThousandForms.description: Passive: while shapeshifted, heal 3 + druid level × 0.3 injury every 250 ticks. Circle of the Moon, druid level 14.
LanguageData.LP_CP_ImprovedCritical.label: improved critical
LanguageData.LP_CP_ImprovedCritical.description: Passive: weapon hits have a 10% chance to deal double damage (15% after superior survivor at level 15). Champion, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_CP_Athlete.label: remarkable athlete
LanguageData.LP_CP_Athlete.description: Passive: movement +0.3, carry capacity +15, melee dodge +5. Champion, fighter level 7.
LanguageData.LP_CP_SecondStyle.label: additional fighting style
LanguageData.LP_CP_SecondStyle.description: Passive: melee hit ×1.08, shooting accuracy ×1.08, armor +5%. Champion, fighter level 11.
LanguageData.LP_CP_Survivor.label: survivor
LanguageData.LP_CP_Survivor.description: Passive: while total injuries exceed 20, heal 5 + Constitution modifier every 250 ticks; improved critical's double damage chance rises to 15%. Champion, fighter level 15.
LanguageData.LP_DT_SacredWeapon.label: sacred weapon
LanguageData.LP_DT_SacredWeapon.description: Sanctify your weapon for 30 seconds: melee hit +25%, the first weapon hit every 2 seconds adds 6 × divine power radiant damage (doubled against undead and fiends). Divinity 1, cooldown 30 seconds. Oath of Devotion, paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_DT_TurnUnholy.label: turn the unholy
LanguageData.LP_DT_TurnUnholy.description: Hostile undead within radius 6 flee for 10 seconds. Divinity 1, cooldown 30 seconds. Oath of Devotion, paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_DT_AuraDevotion.label: aura of devotion
LanguageData.LP_DT_AuraDevotion.description: Passive: allies within 3 cells get mind resistance +30%, break threshold -5%. Oath of Devotion, paladin level 7.
LanguageData.LP_DT_PurityOfSpirit.label: purifying touch
LanguageData.LP_DT_PurityOfSpirit.description: Purify one ally within 12 cells (can be yourself): removes toxins, shaken and panic. Divinity 1, cooldown 20 seconds. Oath of Devotion, paladin level 11.
LanguageData.LP_DT_HolyNimbus.label: holy nimbus
LanguageData.LP_DT_HolyNimbus.description: Wreathe yourself in holy light for 30 seconds: enemies within radius 3 take 8 × divine power radiant damage every 2 seconds (doubled against undead and fiends), and you take ×0.8 damage. Divinity 3, cooldown 1 hour. Oath of Devotion, paladin level 15.
LanguageData.LP_VN_VowOfEnmity.label: vow of vengeance
LanguageData.LP_VN_VowOfEnmity.description: Swear a vow against one enemy within 12 cells for 1 hour: your damage against it rises (with divine power). Divinity 1, cooldown 30 seconds. Oath of Vengeance, paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_VN_AbjureEnemy.label: abjure enemy
LanguageData.LP_VN_AbjureEnemy.description: A furious roar: enemies within radius 5 are shaken for 10 seconds (movement ×0.7, lower hit chance). Divinity 1, cooldown 30 seconds. Oath of Vengeance, paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_VN_RelentlessAvenger.label: relentless avenger
LanguageData.LP_VN_RelentlessAvenger.description: Passive: melee hits on the vowed target deal ×1.2 damage, and movement +0.5 for 5 seconds. Oath of Vengeance, paladin level 7.
LanguageData.LP_VN_SoulOfVengeance.label: soul of vengeance
LanguageData.LP_VN_SoulOfVengeance.description: For 30 seconds melee cooldown ×0.7, melee dodge +10. Divinity 2, cooldown 1 hour. Oath of Vengeance, paladin level 11.
LanguageData.LP_VN_AvengingAngel.label: avenging angel
LanguageData.LP_VN_AvengingAngel.description: Become an avenging angel for 1 hour: movement ×1.4, melee damage ×1.2; the moment the wings spread, enemies within radius 6 are shaken for 10 seconds. Divinity 3, cooldown 1 hour. Oath of Vengeance, paladin level 15.
LanguageData.LP_WD_WarPriest.label: war priest
LanguageData.LP_WD_WarPriest.description: Passive: melee hit +10%, shooting accuracy +4%, armor +8%. War Domain, cleric level 1.
LanguageData.LP_WD_GuidedStrike.label: channel divinity: guided strike
LanguageData.LP_WD_GuidedStrike.description: For 10 seconds melee hit +50%, shooting accuracy +30%. Channel Divinity 1, no divinity cost, cooldown 1 hour. War Domain, cleric level 2.
LanguageData.LP_WD_WarGodBlessing.label: war god's blessing
LanguageData.LP_WD_WarGodBlessing.description: One ally within 20 cells gets melee hit +30% and shooting accuracy +10% for 30 seconds. Divinity 1, cooldown 20 seconds. War Domain, cleric level 6.
LanguageData.LP_WD_DivineStrike.label: divine strike: weapon
LanguageData.LP_WD_DivineStrike.description: Passive: the first weapon hit every 2 seconds adds 8 × divine power damage of the same type (16 from level 14). War Domain, cleric level 8.
LanguageData.LP_WD_Avatar.label: avatar of battle
LanguageData.LP_WD_Avatar.description: Become an avatar of battle for 1 hour: damage taken ×0.75, melee damage ×1.3, melee cooldown ×0.8. Divinity 3, cooldown 1 hour. War Domain, cleric level 17.
LanguageData.LP_KD_Blessings.label: blessings of knowledge
LanguageData.LP_KD_Blessings.description: Passive: research speed ×1.25, learning speed ×1.2. Knowledge Domain, cleric level 1.
LanguageData.LP_KD_KnowledgeOfAges.label: channel divinity: knowledge of the ages
LanguageData.LP_KD_KnowledgeOfAges.description: For 1 hour crafting speed ×1.3, global work speed ×1.2. Channel Divinity 1, no divinity cost, once per day. Knowledge Domain, cleric level 2.
LanguageData.LP_KD_ReadThoughts.label: read mind
LanguageData.LP_KD_ReadThoughts.description: Read the thoughts of one enemy within 15 cells for 30 seconds: melee dodge -20, damage taken ×1.15; humanlike targets who fail to block it with mind resistance are also shaken for 10 seconds. Divinity 1, cooldown 20 seconds. Knowledge Domain, cleric level 6.
LanguageData.LP_KD_PotentSpellcasting.label: potent spellcasting
LanguageData.LP_KD_PotentSpellcasting.description: Passive: cleric divine magic power ×1.15. Knowledge Domain, cleric level 8.
LanguageData.LP_KD_Visions.label: visions of the past
LanguageData.LP_KD_Visions.description: Enemies within radius 8 are stunned by visions of the past: shaken for 10 seconds, and those who fail to block it with mind resistance are also stunned for 3 seconds. Divinity 3, cooldown 1 hour. Knowledge Domain, cleric level 17.
LanguageData.LP_GD_EyesOfGrave.label: eyes of the grave
LanguageData.LP_GD_EyesOfGrave.description: Passive: necrotic damage taken halved. Grave Domain, cleric level 1.
LanguageData.LP_GD_PathToGrave.label: channel divinity: path to the grave
LanguageData.LP_GD_PathToGrave.description: Mark one enemy within 15 cells for 10 seconds: the next attack against it deals ×2 damage. Channel Divinity 1, no divinity cost, cooldown 1 hour. Grave Domain, cleric level 2.
LanguageData.LP_GD_SentinelAtDeath.label: sentinel at death's door
LanguageData.LP_GD_SentinelAtDeath.description: Passive: when casting healing divine magic on an ally with over 20 injuries, heal the same amount once more. Grave Domain, cleric level 6.
LanguageData.LP_GD_Potent.label: potent spellcasting
LanguageData.LP_GD_Potent.description: Passive: cleric divine magic power ×1.15. Grave Domain, cleric level 8.
LanguageData.LP_GD_KeeperOfSouls.label: keeper of souls
LanguageData.LP_GD_KeeperOfSouls.description: Passive: when an enemy dies within 10 cells, you and allies within 4 cells each heal 10 + cleric level injury (at most once every 10 seconds). Grave Domain, cleric level 17.
LanguageData.LP_HX_Curse.label: hexblade's curse
LanguageData.LP_HX_Curse.description: Curse one enemy within 15 cells for 30 seconds: it takes ×1.25 damage (×1.5 with master of hexes at level 15); when it dies you heal 5 + warlock level injury. Pact mana 1, cooldown 10 seconds. The Hexblade patron, warlock level 1.
LanguageData.LP_HX_Warrior.label: hex warrior
LanguageData.LP_HX_Warrior.description: Passive: melee hit +15%, armor +10%. The Hexblade patron, warlock level 3.
LanguageData.LP_HX_Armor.label: armor of hexes
LanguageData.LP_HX_Armor.description: Don armor of the Shadowfell for 30 seconds: damage taken ×0.8. Pact mana 1, cooldown 30 seconds. The Hexblade patron, warlock level 7.
LanguageData.LP_HX_Specter.label: accursed specter
LanguageData.LP_HX_Specter.description: A spectral shadow slashes around you for 30 seconds: enemies within radius 2.5 take 6 × pact power damage every 2 seconds. Pact mana 2, cooldown 1 hour. The Hexblade patron, warlock level 11.
LanguageData.LP_HX_MasterOfHexes.label: master of hexes
LanguageData.LP_HX_MasterOfHexes.description: Passive: targets of hexblade's curse take ×1.5 damage (originally ×1.25), and its damage against you ×0.8. The Hexblade patron, warlock level 15.
LanguageData.LP_CE_HealingLight.label: healing light
LanguageData.LP_CE_HealingLight.description: One ally within 12 cells (can be yourself) instantly heals 12 × pact power injury, bleeding wounds first. Pact mana 1, cooldown 15 seconds. The Celestial patron, warlock level 1.
LanguageData.LP_CE_RadiantSoul.label: radiant soul
LanguageData.LP_CE_RadiantSoul.description: Passive: healing light and radiant wrath power ×1.2. The Celestial patron, warlock level 3.
LanguageData.LP_CE_Resilience.label: celestial resistance
LanguageData.LP_CE_Resilience.description: You and allies within 4 cells each get a shield absorbing 6 + warlock level damage (1 hour). Pact mana 1, cooldown 1 hour. The Celestial patron, warlock level 7.
LanguageData.LP_CE_RadiantBurst.label: radiant wrath
LanguageData.LP_CE_RadiantBurst.description: One enemy within 20 cells takes 16 × pact power radiant damage (doubled against undead and fiends). Pact mana 1, cooldown 10 seconds. The Celestial patron, warlock level 11.
LanguageData.LP_CE_SearingVengeance.label: searing vengeance
LanguageData.LP_CE_SearingVengeance.description: Passive: the first time each day you'd be downed, heal half your wounds and stand back up, and enemies within radius 4 take 10 × pact power radiant damage. The Celestial patron, warlock level 15.
LanguageData.LP_NM_GrimHarvest.label: grim harvest
LanguageData.LP_NM_GrimHarvest.description: Passive: when an enemy you killed is within 10 cells, heal 5 + wizard level injury. School of Necromancy, wizard level 2.
LanguageData.LP_NM_UndeadThralls.label: undead thralls
LanguageData.LP_NM_UndeadThralls.description: Raise a humanlike corpse within 10 cells as a servant. Mana 2, cooldown 1 hour. School of Necromancy, wizard level 6.
LanguageData.LP_NM_InuredToUndeath.label: inured to undeath
LanguageData.LP_NM_InuredToUndeath.description: Passive: necrotic damage taken halved, toxic resistance +50%. School of Necromancy, wizard level 10.
LanguageData.LP_NM_CommandUndead.label: command undead
LanguageData.LP_NM_CommandUndead.description: Take a hostile undead within 15 cells under your control for 1 hour (undead horde, necromantic constructs, death knights, etc.; half success against bosses). Mana 3, cooldown 1 hour. School of Necromancy, wizard level 14.
LanguageData.LP_DI_Portent.label: portent
LanguageData.LP_DI_Portent.description: Passive: twice per day, re-roll one of your own failed saves. School of Divination, wizard level 2.
LanguageData.LP_DI_ExpertDivination.label: expert divination
LanguageData.LP_DI_ExpertDivination.description: Passive: wizard spell cooldowns ×0.85 after casting. School of Divination, wizard level 6.
LanguageData.LP_DI_ThirdEye.label: the third eye
LanguageData.LP_DI_ThirdEye.description: For 1 hour sight +30%, shooting accuracy +10%, melee dodge +10. No mana cost, once per day. School of Divination, wizard level 10.
LanguageData.LP_DI_GreaterPortent.label: greater portent
LanguageData.LP_DI_GreaterPortent.description: Passive: portent becomes 3 times per day. School of Divination, wizard level 14.
LanguageData.LP_AJ_ArcaneWard.label: arcane ward
LanguageData.LP_AJ_ArcaneWard.description: Give yourself a shield absorbing 8 + wizard level × 2 damage (1 hour, doesn't stack, refreshes). Mana 1, cooldown 30 seconds. School of Abjuration, wizard level 2.
LanguageData.LP_AJ_ProjectedWard.label: projected ward
LanguageData.LP_AJ_ProjectedWard.description: One ally within 12 cells gets a shield absorbing 8 + wizard level × 2 damage (1 hour). Mana 1, cooldown 30 seconds. School of Abjuration, wizard level 6.
LanguageData.LP_AJ_ImprovedAbjuration.label: improved abjuration
LanguageData.LP_AJ_ImprovedAbjuration.description: Passive: mind resistance +25%, armor +8%. School of Abjuration, wizard level 10.
LanguageData.LP_AJ_SpellResistance.label: spell resistance
LanguageData.LP_AJ_SpellResistance.description: Passive: all damage taken ×0.85. School of Abjuration, wizard level 14.
LanguageData.LP_IU_ImprovedMinor.label: illusion savant
LanguageData.LP_IU_ImprovedMinor.description: Passive: a wavering form, melee dodge +8. School of Illusion, wizard level 2.
LanguageData.LP_IU_MalleableIllusions.label: malleable illusions
LanguageData.LP_IU_MalleableIllusions.description: Enemies within radius 5 are scared off by illusions for 10 seconds (mind resistance can block it; bosses unaffected). Mana 2, cooldown 30 seconds. School of Illusion, wizard level 6.
LanguageData.LP_IU_IllusorySelf.label: illusory self
LanguageData.LP_IU_IllusorySelf.description: Passive: the first time each day you'd be downed, leave an illusion behind and flicker to another spot within 5 cells, healing a quarter of your wounds. School of Illusion, wizard level 10.
LanguageData.LP_IU_IllusoryReality.label: illusory reality
LanguageData.LP_IU_IllusoryReality.description: Illusions made real: for 30 seconds gain 5 × arcane power mirror images (each hit consumes one and misses). Mana 3, cooldown 1 hour. School of Illusion, wizard level 14.
LanguageData.LP_SB_FancyFootwork.label: fancy footwork
LanguageData.LP_SB_FancyFootwork.description: Passive: movement +0.3, melee dodge +10. Swashbuckler, rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_SB_RakishAudacity.label: rakish audacity
LanguageData.LP_SB_RakishAudacity.description: Passive: in single combat (no other allies of yours next to the target), melee damage ×1.2. Swashbuckler, rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_SB_Panache.label: panache
LanguageData.LP_SB_Panache.description: Say a few charming words to one humanlike enemy within 10 cells: charm it for 30 seconds (it lays down its hostility; mind resistance can block it). No resource cost, cooldown 1 hour. Swashbuckler, rogue level 7.
LanguageData.LP_SB_ElegantManeuver.label: elegant maneuver
LanguageData.LP_SB_ElegantManeuver.description: For 10 seconds melee hit +20%, melee dodge +15. No resource cost, cooldown 20 seconds. Swashbuckler, rogue level 11.
LanguageData.LP_SB_MasterDuelist.label: master duelist
LanguageData.LP_SB_MasterDuelist.description: For 20 seconds melee damage ×1.3, melee dodge +25. No resource cost, cooldown 1 hour. Swashbuckler, rogue level 15.
LanguageData.LP_SN_PsychicBlades.label: psychic blades
LanguageData.LP_SN_PsychicBlades.description: Congeal a blade from psychic force for 1 hour: melee damage ×1.25, melee cooldown ×0.9. No resource cost, cooldown 10 seconds. Soulknife, rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_SN_PsionicPower.label: psionic power
LanguageData.LP_SN_PsionicPower.description: Passive: psychic sensitivity +20%, mind resistance +20%. Soulknife, rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_SN_SoulThrow.label: soul blade throw
LanguageData.LP_SN_SoulThrow.description: Hurl a soul blade at one enemy within 12 cells: 10 × cunning power psychic damage. No resource cost, cooldown 6 seconds. Soulknife, rogue level 7.
LanguageData.LP_SN_PsychicVeil.label: psychic veil
LanguageData.LP_SN_PsychicVeil.description: For 10 seconds movement ×1.2, melee dodge +20. No resource cost, cooldown 1 hour. Soulknife, rogue level 11.
LanguageData.LP_SN_RendMind.label: rend mind
LanguageData.LP_SN_RendMind.description: Rend the mind of one enemy within 12 cells: 20 × cunning power psychic damage, and those who fail to block it with mind resistance are also stunned for 3 seconds. No resource cost, cooldown 1 hour. Soulknife, rogue level 15.
